I didn't want to play this game seriously at first, but around level 30 I started to realize I liked this game too much to not try the competitive side of it.

Honestly, they just need to make a "Death Match" casual queue. Because having an objective-based game mode where players aren't taking it seriously, while others are, just causes conflict. Some people define fun as "Doing your best to win," and others define it as "Goofing around."

In a Team Death Match setting, both play styles could be accommodated. Try-hards could try hard since their personal score would matter more to them than winning. Casual players could just enjoy the game.

But the current game modes of "push this" and "capture that" in a casual setting don't work. For me personally, I'm perfectly fine with goofing around and having fun. But I also like to play the objective; I enjoy winning and trying to win. If my team is off playing TDM instead of pushing the payload or defending the objective, then the game becomes unfun and frustrating.

I'm hoping that they'll release a casual TDM queue alongside the current Quick Play queues. That way, casual players who like to goof off will gravitate towards TDM, and players who enjoy playing the objective while still just enjoying the game will gravitate towards Payload/King of the Hill (they really need to separate these queues, in my opinion). And with competitive, all the try-hards will have a place to funnel into.

I feel like this would be the optimal way to ensure everyone can enjoy the game.
